name: liquid-gradient
title: Liquid gradient
description: A plum, crimson and amber gradient swirls and settles. It loops with no join.

props.name: deep
props.doc: The darkest colour, where the field is low (plum).

props.name: mid
props.doc: The colour pooled along one side and between the others (crimson).

props.name: bright
props.doc: The brightest colour, where the field is high (amber).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Size of the shapes: higher is larger, calmer pools.

props.name: swirl
props.doc: How far the shapes fold over in the middle of the loop.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Loops per 10 seconds. Whole numbers loop seamlessly.

props.name: softness
props.doc: How soft the edges between colours are.
